races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase
Irish Stallion Farms EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
DOCTOR STEINBERG looked a top-class prospect when demolishing 7 rivals in a Grade 1 novice hurdle last season and, though things did not go to plan afterwards, is likely to prove hard to beat now switched to fences. The highly promising Court Compliance is feared most, while Fort Dino is also respected after an encouraging chase debut.

  1. DOCTOR STEINBERG (IRE)
  2. COURT COMPLIANCE (IRE)
  3. FORT DINO (FR)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
IAMAGETAWAY showed improved form to get off the mark over fences at Downpatrick 41 days ago and looks capable of defying an 8 lb rise back in handicap company. Hees Dynamite is well handicapped on his hurdling form and is feared most, while That's About Right and Doctor Confusion are also respected.

  1. IAMAGETAWAY (IRE)
  2. HEES DYNAMITE (IRE)
  3. THAT'S ABOUT RIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
HI HO IDAHO has a little bit to find with Minella Emperor off level weights but his profile is a more convincing one, so he's awarded the vote.

  1. HI HO IDAHO (IRE)
  2. MINELLA EMPEROR (IRE)
  3. BROTHER WALFRID (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
I DONT REALLY CARE matched her previous best despite finding the test inadequate when third over 2m at Cork 18 days ago and, with the return to this sort of trip looking much more suitable, she looks to hold sound claims. That said, Light Up The Dark is surely capable of better than she showed when second on hurdles debut at Galway last month and better is anticipated up in trip. Dinner Dance is another to note on hurdles bow.

  1. I DONT REALLY CARE (IRE)
  2. LIGHT UP THE DARK
  3. DINNER DANCE (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
COCK AND BULL has progressed on the Flat since last seen over hurdles and will take plenty of beating if transferring that form back to this sphere from a mark that appears to underestimate his true ability. Migdam is feared most after an interesting trainer switch and some help from the handicapper, while Crowsatedappletart and Demanding Gerry look best of the rest.

  1. COCK AND BULL (IRE)
  2. MIGDAM (FR)
  3. CROWSATEDAPPLETART (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again On The 26th November Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
LICEO has knocked firmly at the door since returning from a short break, again finding only one too good over C&D last week and there appears no reason why he won't make a bold bid again from an unchanged mark. Max Meridius shaped well when a place behind the selection that day and can lay down a serious challenge if consenting to race more efficiently, whilst Phoenix Arizona is another worth a look operating from a lower hurdles mark.

  1. LICEO (FR)
  2. MAX MERIDIUS (IRE)
  3. PHOENIX ARIZONA (IRE)

races.name: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com (Q.R.) Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
A thin maiden and in the hope he takes to hurdling at the first attempt, MARHABA GHAIYYATH may well be up to conceding weight all round given his Flat ability. Point recruit Legendary Status is the obvious alternative for Willie Mullins.

  1. MARHABA GHAIYYATH (IRE)
  2. LEGENDARY STATUS (IRE)
  3. QUINLAN (IRE)

races.name: Hazelton Mountford Insurance Brokers EBF Fillies' Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A field of newcomers. LESLIE'S PRIDE is from a talented family and is taken to get her career off to a winning start. Saq of Gold is second choice.

  1. LESLIE'S PRIDE (IRE)
  2. SAQ OF GOLD
  3. NOBLE FLEUR (FR)

races.name: Olly Murphy Proudly Sponsored By Betano 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
FRIENDLY GLANCE was quite a taking winner of his Doncaster bumper and he's fancied to make a successful start over hurdles that features several interesting debutants to this sphere, with Power of Silence and L'Unique Allen chief amongst them.

  1. FRIENDLY GLANCE
  2. POWER OF SILENCE (IRE)
  3. L'UNIQUE ALLEN (FR)

races.name: Olly Murphy Proudly Sponsored By Betano 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Plenty of similarities to the first division with race sponsor Olly Murphy again mob-handed, CROOKHAVEN getting the vote to make a winning start under Rules having easily won an Irish point back in the spring. Stablemate Burk Flight has a French jumps pedigree, so he looks an obvious threat with attentions quickly switched to hurdles, with Smile John Boy, Roximan and Bebe And Bean just a handful of others worth considering, too.

  1. CROOKHAVEN
  2. BURK FLIGHT (FR)
  3. SMILE JOHN BOY (IRE)

races.name: Great British Bonus Supporting Breeders' Day Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
There's a chance this could be a pipe-opener for LARGY FORCE back over hurdles after 6 months off but she would prove very hard to beat if she does replicate her chasing form. Capricciose showed a fair bit in bumpers and is expected to step up on her hurdles debut, while Emiko is an interesting debutant over hurdles.

  1. LARGY FORCE (IRE)
  2. CAPRICCIOSE (IRE)
  3. EMIKO (IRE)

races.name: Denis O'Connell Memorial Veterans' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
This looks wide open so a chance is taken on KNAPPERS HILL off his reduced mark given his excellent record fresh. Git Maker is another to consider down in class, while Tom Lacey holds a strong hand with last year's winner Nocte Volatus and Pounding Poet, who's had little racing over fences despite his veteran status.

  1. KNAPPERS HILL (IRE)
  2. GIT MAKER (FR)
  3. NOCTE VOLATUS

races.name: Omoda And Jaecoo Race To Victory Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
STRONG RUN is still low mileage in handicaps and makes appeal quickly reverted to the smaller obstacles after a luckless chase debut. Easy To Follow is also respected on her comeback, whilst Party Vibes rates as an interesting candidate from her lower hurdles mark.

  1. STRONG RUN
  2. EASY TO FOLLOW (IRE)
  3. PARTY VIBES (IRE)

races.name: Grumpy & Granny's Golden Gallops Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
INDANNYA did well over hurdles last season but very much appeals as the type to take her form to a higher level over fences, hence her inclusion in the Timeform Fifty To Follow. Coolanna is another who could well improve on her hurdling form now sent chasing given her pointing background. Broomfield Aderra looks to be being brought along gradually over fences and remains capable of better fitted with first-time cheekpieces.

  1. INDANNYA (FR)
  2. COOLANNA (IRE)
  3. BROOMFIELD ADERRA (IRE)

races.name: Thoroughbred Breeders' Association Supporting Breeders' Day Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A well-contested race of its type. OLIVE NOIR makes plenty of appeal on paper for a yard with a fine record in bumpers, so she earns the tentative vote before market clues. Galant Jewel and Fiercestone have both been successful on their second outing in Irish points and can put that experience to good use, while Autumn In Sonora is another to note being a half-sister to smart hurdler/useful chase winner Potters Charm.

  1. OLIVE NOIR (IRE)
  2. GALANT JEWEL (IRE)
  3. FIERCESTONE (IRE)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SILK BRAID looked promising when scoring on debut and then was an improved second in listed company at Navan in April, shaping as if longer trips would suit so she's taken to make a winning start for a new yard on return from 7 months off. Nascondino has produced solid form of late and has a top rider aboard so he should capitalise if the returning selection doesn't give her running.

  1. SILK BRAID (IRE)
  2. NASCONDINO (IRE)
  3. ZERIYA

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict:
BOY BASILICA won impressively over 9f at Wolverhampton 23 days ago and is open to plenty more progress making nursery debut. He can prove too good for hat-trick seeking Rogue Imperial, who produced his best display when upped to this trip at Epsom in September. Arthur Carrot has a bigger performance in him if settling better so could be one for the places, too.

  1. BOY BASILICA (FR)
  2. ROGUE IMPERIAL
  3. ARTHUR CARROT

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun / EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
This is unlikely to take much winning so the 2 newcomers must be on the shortlist, with VALLEY RISING preferred to Anaream. She Is Mighty is another to consider having gone close at Catterick last month.

  1. VALLEY RISING
  2. ANAREAM
  3. SHE IS MIGHTY

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun / EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
CLASSIC BELLINI showed improved form when runner-up at Southwell last time, despite having been caught further back than ideal, and she can build on that effort to go one better. The main danger could be Freshie who showed encouragement on her first start, with Star Run one to note on debut.

  1. CLASSIC BELLINI
  2. FRESHIE
  3. STAR RUN

races.name: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for ZOOELLA, who resumed her progress with a decisive victory at Southwell last month. She is fancied to record a fourth win of the year with more still to offer, though Startling isn't taken lightly after readily making all at Chelmsford on her latest outing, while Rajiba could go well back down in trip.

  1. ZOOELLA (IRE)
  2. STARTLING
  3. RAJIBA

races.name: All-Weather Championships Season XIV River Eden EBF Fillies' Stakes (Listed) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
LIKEALOT and Morrophore stand out on their best form, with the former preferred having shown it more recently. Unexposed 3-y-o Yamnah is the potential fly in the ointment.

  1. LIKEALOT
  2. MORROPHORE (FR)
  3. YAMNAH (FR)

races.name: All-Weather Championships Season XIV Fleur De Lys Fillies' Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
Last year's heroine SKY SAFARI enhanced her fine record on speed-favouring all-weather tracks when landing the Winter Derby here back in February. Lightly raced and better than form figures would suggest thereafter, this has likely been her target again and James Fanshawe's mare rates a big player again. Kon Tiki (2-2 on all-weather) will find this more suitable than her Group 1 assignment latest and is feared, with improving 3-y-o Enchanted Queen also making the shortlist up in class.

  1. SKY SAFARI
  2. KON TIKI
  3. ENCHANTED QUEEN

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap
races.verdict:
The likelihood of a strong pace to aim at ought to play firmly to the strengths of CREDIT FORGEDD IT who arrives on the back of solid placed efforts and starts out for a new yard who boast a very good record with similar types. Cooramook despite a potentially tricky draw, Snaafy and The Caribbean from his reduced mark are others to consider.

  1. CREDIT FORGEDD IT (IRE)
  2. COORAMOOK (IRE)
  3. SNAAFY

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict:
GOT THE BOOTY has quickly found her feet for Clive Cox so she's fancied to go one better than on her last couple of starts with first-time cheekpieces applied. Nogo's Dream went close at Wolverhampton on penultimate start and having shaped as if still in good form in the mud at Bath since, he's put forward as the main threat. Magna may prove best of the rest.

  1. GOT THE BOOTY (FR)
  2. NOGO'S DREAM
  3. MAGNA

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A case can be made for most of these, but preference is for SAVVY DISKO, who suffered an unpleasant fall at Glorious Goodwood when bidding for a hat-trick but got back on track at Yarmouth a couple of months ago. He can make a winning start on all-weather at the expense of Stoneacre Donny, who was edged out by a course specialist over C&D recently. Water To Wine can edge out Paddy The Squire for third.

  1. SAVVY DISKO (IRE)
  2. STONEACRE DONNY
  3. WATER TO WINE (FR)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Only a handful make any serious appeal in this big-field novice, EL RA'ADY taken to make a successful debut for powerful connections. Nip About built on his debut promise returned to a more suitable trip when runner-up over C&D and he may have to settle for silver again, with Big Money and stable-switcher Janora taken to fight out third.

  1. EL RA'ADY (IRE)
  2. NIP ABOUT
  3. BIG MONEY

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Nursery
races.verdict:
ANGELIC MELODY is drawn on the wing but shaped quite well when fourth on nursery debut at Southwell and can improve further here to get off the mark. North Coates improved when second at Musselburgh last time and is respected with the step back up to 6f likely to suit, whilst Ma Fille de Reve remains of interest on her Thirsk second.

  1. ANGELIC MELODY (IRE)
  2. NORTH COATES
  3. MA FILLE DE REVE

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
HIGH THRESHOLD showed enough to win a normal race of this type when a slightly unlucky second on debut and he can go one place better. Idealise should benefit from the experience of his Kempton debut and is most feared, whilst the Gosden-trained newcomer Tabkir also makes appeal on paper.

  1. HIGH THRESHOLD (IRE)
  2. IDEALISE
  3. TABKIR

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
SEDE VACANTE is an expensive €550,000 purchase making his debut and, being a half-brother to a 7f winner out of a dam who stayed 1¼m, is entitled to respect and can make a winning start if the market speaks in his favour. On A Boat That Day is another newcomer that makes appeal on paper, but Shimmering Shadow looks the pick of those with experience to their name.

  1. SEDE VACANTE (IRE)
  2. SHIMMERING SHADOW (IRE)
  3. ON A BOAT THAT DAY (IRE)

races.name: AWC Is Back Handicap
races.verdict:
FRANKIES DREAM goes particularly well at this track and is easily excused a recent outing on soft going so he's liable to prove a real threat if things unfold well for him from stall 14. Intrusively is a recent course winner and showed better signs again last time so should be in the mix, while We Dare To Dream looks very well treated again now.

  1. FRANKIES DREAM (IRE)
  2. INTRUSIVELY
  3. WE DARE TO DREAM (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict:
It could be worth chancing WE NEVER STOP, who often keeps better company and may be rekindled by the return to all-weather. Starmade is the obvious threat back at this venue after his encouraging third at Wolverhampton, with Lorna B another to consider having proved she's still on the upgrade after her comeback win last month.

  1. WE NEVER STOP (IRE)
  2. STARMADE (IRE)
  3. LORNA B (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
races.verdict:
REAL JACK wasted no time getting back on track when runner-up at Musselburgh last time and, having gone close on his previous start at this venue, he could be ready to open his account. Forever Twenty has run well over this C&D on 2 of her last 3 outings and is feared most, with Liquid Cooled another to consider.

  1. REAL JACK
  2. FOREVER TWENTY
  3. LIQUID COOLED (IRE)

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for 7-time C&D winner Paddy's Day, who has got back on track returned to this venue on his last 2 starts. He is fancied to take advantage of his reduced mark, though Changeofmind remains unexposed on all-weather and heads the list of dangers, ahead of the in-form Kinetic Force.

  1. PADDY'S DAY (IRE)
  2. CHANGEOFMIND (IRE)
  3. KINETIC FORCE

races.name: 4Racing Welcomes You Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
BUFFALO DREAM sets a pretty good standard for a race of this nature so is very much the percentage call. Platinum Shay is perhaps the chief threat, with Wild Camp an appealing debutante.

  1. BUFFALO DREAM (SAF)
  2. PLATINUM SHAY (SAF)
  3. WILD CAMP (SAF)

races.name: #youcanbetonus! Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
SENDAI has had plenty of chances now but he didn't do a lot wrong when second over 5f here 2 weeks ago. This could be his chance, with Baldur a danger, while Katoomba could easily step up plenty on his debut form.

  1. SENDAI (SAF)
  2. BALDUR (SAF)
  3. KATOOMBA (SAF)

races.name: Tab Casino Mr 95 Open Handicap (3 Years Old)
races.verdict:
WHAT A WARRIOR sets a tall standard so will take some stopping if seeing out this new trip. Trojan Horse looks the best bet for the runner-up spot, while Up And Up might well have a say too.

  1. WHAT A WARRIOR (SAF)
  2. TROJAN HORSE (SAF)
  3. UP AND UP (SAF)

races.name: Betway Summer Cup 28 November Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
STORM AVALANCHE was the beaten market choice last time out, but is taken to bounce back and make the most of this opportunity. Nixie Girl is put forward as the best option for the forecast , while Mulholland Drive merits respect also.

  1. STORM AVALANCHE (SAF)
  2. NIXIE GIRL (SAF)
  3. MULHOLLAND DRIVE (SAF)

races.name: Racing Today Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
STEEL PIER failed to justify market expectations on his most recent run but it was still another excellent in second and he appeals as the most likely winner. Brave Eagle gets the nod among the others, while The Name of Dladla can make the first three as well.

  1. STEEL PIER (SAF)
  2. BRAVE EAGLE (SAF)
  3. THE NAME OF DLADLA (SAF)

races.name: Tickets At Howler For The Betway Summer Cup Conditions Plate
races.verdict:
RADIO STAR added another win to his tally 4 weeks ago and is just about the pick in what is a deep contest. Fire Storm looks the likeliest to finish second, while Yippee Kiyay shouldn't be far away.

  1. RADIO STAR (SAF)
  2. FIRE STORM (SAF)
  3. YIPPEE KIYAY (SAF)

races.name: Play Soccer 6, 10 And 13 Mr 108 Handicap
races.verdict:
PIVOTAL ROLE was back to his best on his latest run and should make a bold show. Catfish is the most realistic next preference, while Echo Check is another to come into the reckoning.

  1. PIVOTAL ROLE (SAF)
  2. CATFISH (SAF)
  3. ECHO CHECK (SAF)

races.name: www.tab.co.za Fm 87 Divided Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
STAGGERWING produced another solid effort when second 4 weeks ago and she looks the pick of the weights. Wings of Kildra gets the nod among the rest, while There She Goes is another worth looking at.

  1. STAGGERWING (SAF)
  2. WINGS OF KILDRA (SAF)
  3. THERE SHE GOES (SAF)

races.name: Tab Telebet 011 074 0300 Fm 75 Divided Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
ASTROPHILE has been in good heart of late and is probably the one to beat. Star Blaze ought to be involved as well, while Beautiful Rosie commands a closer look.

  1. ASTROPHILE (SAF)
  2. STAR BLAZE (SAF)
  3. BEAUTIFUL ROSIE (AUS)

races.name: Next Tab Vaal Racemeeting Thursday 26 November Mr 74 Handicap
races.verdict:
EIFFEL TOWER is running well enough to gain a deserved success. Longsword is the most realistic next preference, while Proper is the other candidate for the three.

  1. EIFFEL TOWER (SAF)
  2. LONGSWORD (SAF)
  3. PROPER (SAF)
